class.name: CbItemIcon
class.brief_description: What the row's item looks like: its icon.
class.description: In a row of a [CbList] (of slots, of items): the icon of that row's item, nothing for none. The icon is its kind's [member CbItem.icon]; without one, the game takes a picture of the item's scene once (its meshes, framed from the front and a little above, on a clear background) and keeps it.
